name: Pat Wattam
bio:
Arkansas is my home state, where I received my Bachelor’s degree in music education. After a career in music, including a Master of Music degree from Michigan State University, a private woodwind studio in Nashville, a seat in the pit orchestra at Opryland USA and teaching woodwinds at the college level, my husband took a position at Louisiana State University. The move to Baton Rouge was the start of my real estate career.

I was a top-producing solo agent and an active member of the Greater Baton Rouge Board of REALTORS®, where I was named Most Cooperative Realtor and Realtor of the Year, and served as President of the board. Education has been the key to my success, and I have spoken at many national real estate events.

Building a team of like-minded friends, many with music backgrounds of their own, led to the team’s continued success. After 43 years in real estate, I now serve as the team’s consultant, advising clients on their options, staging, pricing and the market.

reviews.quote: Pat Wattam and team did a fantastic job for my husband and me. I was in the real estate business for 37 years. When it came time to market our own home, it was impossible for me to choose between former sales associates, good friends, and neighbors. Therefore, we went with the Pat Wattam team. They were competent, efficient, patient, and successful. We had an accepted contract hours after putting our house on the market and closed the sale in 30 days. You can’t ask for better results than that!
